runs.answer: Paula Reid's new title at MS NOW is Chief White House Reporter, based in the network's Washington bureau. MS NOW confirmed the hire on Thursday, October 29, 2026 (Deadline published the story that morning at 7:05 a.m.; the network's PR account announced it the same day), with her first day that Thursday. runs.title: Jesús de Miguel: what happened and the club's word
runs.prompt: CD Tenerife striker Jesús de Miguel was taken off unconscious in an ambulance after a serious head injury during a Segunda División (Spanish second tier) match against Andorra, which was abandoned. Find out what happened, his current condition, and what the club or medical officials have said. Use a factual, non-paywalled news source and keep it respectful.
runs.answer: Jesús de Miguel collapsed and was carried off unconscious in an ambulance during Tenerife's home game with FC Andorra, which was abandoned in the 97th minute at 2-2 in front of 13,018 fans. AS reports he suffered a cardiac arrest ("paro cardiaco") after a collision with Andorra goalkeeper Jesús Owono, and quotes the referee's match report describing an opponent going in "bruscamente con su pierna en alto... con uso de fuerza excesiva" (a high leg with excessive force); Marca headlined that he was admitted to intensive care after the clash. The club's official statement ("Comunicado oficial: Jesús de Miguel") says he is in the ICU of the Hospital Universitario Nuestra Señora de Candelaria and is "estable dentro de la gravedad" — stable but serious — with the club saying it will pass on further medical updates when they come. Andorra marked the fixture "abandonat" and headlined their match report "El partit i el resultat, el de menys" (the game and the result are the least of it) — all as of the evening of Monday 2 November 2026; no later prognosis had been published.

runs.title: Melbourne Cup: time and Flemington weather
runs.prompt: The 2026 Melbourne Cup is being run on Tuesday November 3, 2026 at Flemington Racecourse, and heavy rain and possible flash floods are forecast to affect the day. Find out what time the race starts (in AEST / Melbourne time and at least one other Australian timezone), and what the weather forecast and track rating currently are for Flemington. runs.answer: The 2026 Melbourne Cup is race 7 of 10 at Flemington on Tuesday Nov 3, starting **3:00pm AEDT** (Vic, NSW, Tas, ACT) — equal to **2:00pm AEST in Queensland**, 2:30pm ACDT in SA, 1:30pm ACST in the NT and 12:00pm AWST in WA (ABC News). The Flemington track was rated a **Good 4** at 9:00am Monday with the rail out 3m the entire circuit — note that is a Monday rating, so recheck on race morning. Important: no source I read mentions flash floods for Cup Day; the stormy weather is Monday's, with conditions clearing Tuesday afternoon, so the brief overstates the threat.

runs.title: Pick the best OSAP single-IP source
runs.prompt: Ontario's Ministry of Colleges and Universities has alleged that thousands of student aid (OSAP) applications originated from a single IP address, raising fraud concerns — a story reported by several Canadian outlets. Compare the coverage from these candidate sources and pick the single most readable, informative, non-paywalled article for someone who wants the clear facts of what the ministry alleged and what happens next. Justify your choice, noting whether any site was paywalled or blocked.
runs.answer: Recommended read: Global News (globalnews.ca/news/12129789/osap-applications-ip-address/), the only one of the three candidates that loaded free and unobstructed for me — no paywall, no bot wall. It carries the full Canadian Press account: the ministry alleges 3,136 of 6,001 applications (52%) at Academy of Learning's Brampton East campus, 3,460 of 6,070 (57%) at North York and 1,736 of 6,966 (25%) at Toronto's Bay Street campus came from single IP addresses in 2025-26, alongside 220+ tips since January 2024 alleging recruiters submitted applications, uploaded documents and completed coursework for students; the colleges deny wrongdoing, all three campuses have been barred from OSAP eligibility, and the province has ordered an independent audit and referred sector-wide concerns to the OPP (allegations unproven in court). Caveat: Global's page is cluttered by a large comment thread that crowds the story text. runs.title: Pick the best Apple earnings source
runs.prompt: Apple's Q4 2026 earnings come out after the bell today, November 2, 2026. Compare these candidate pages and pick the single best place for a reader to get Apple's actual reported results (revenue, iPhone sales, and CEO John Ternus's remarks) without hitting a paywall. Justify your choice and note any paywalls or bot-walls you encountered.
runs.answer: Use CNBC's live-updates page (https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/02/apple-aapl-q4-2026-earnings-live-updates.html): it is free and fully readable with no paywall, and it is a dedicated live blog covering both the after-the-bell release and the 5 p.m. ET call, already carrying consensus figures ($1.99 EPS, $113.39B revenue, $56.59B iPhone sales) and set up to post the actual results and Ternus's remarks. Apple's Investor Relations page is blocked by a Cloudflare bot wall (HTTP 403 "Just a moment..."), MarketBeat shows only estimates and a listen link (listing the call at 6 p.m. ET vs. CNBC's 5 p.m.), and AppleScoop is a free but preview-only piece whose numbers are explicitly expectations. Caveat: at the 4:08 p.m. ET snapshot I read, the actual reported numbers had not yet posted on any candidate page.
